measures.title: Polk County Fairgrounds & Event Center Local Option Tax
measures.summary: Asks whether Polk County may levy a five-year local option property tax of up to $0.12 per $1,000 of assessed value beginning in 2027-2028 for the Polk County Fairgrounds & Event Center. About 35% each year would go to operations and maintenance, and the rest to improvements such as electrical work, parking resurfacing, walkways, building and HVAC upgrades, a main building roof and technology. The county estimates $36 in the first year on a property assessed at $300,000 and about $5.47 million over five years.
measures.yesMeans: Polk County may levy up to $0.12 per $1,000 of assessed value for five years for the Fairgrounds & Event Center.
measures.noMeans: Polk County will not levy this local option tax for the Fairgrounds & Event Center.
